name: Core Index
description: The low-cost, broadly-diversified baseline. Every other config has to beat this one after costs and taxes to justify its complexity. Treat it as the control group, not as the boring option.

sleeves.name: Global equity index
sleeves.rationale: Broad equity is the growth engine. Held as an index because the evidence on persistent stock-picking skill after fees is weak, and because it removes the need to have an opinion on any single company.

sleeves.name: Investment-grade bonds
sleeves.rationale: Ballast. Its job is not return, it is reducing the depth of the drawdown so the plan survives contact with a bad year. Judge it on drawdown, not on yield.

sleeves.name: Cash buffer
sleeves.rationale: Months of expenses held so a forced sale never happens at the worst possible price. This sleeve is a behavioural instrument more than a financial one.
